caption: The drawing depicts a stylized bird-like figure positioned in the center of a plain, beige background. The figure is rendered in shades of brown and gray, with its wings extended horizontally from its body. Feathers are indicated with distinct lines and shading in darker and lighter tones of brown. The head of the figure is raised and shaped in a streamlined manner, with a visible eye and an open beak colored in shades of red and white. The body features some decorative elements, including blue and red accents on its underside, forming a geometric pattern that contrasts with the natural feather colors. The overall composition is simple with the single object centrally placed, and there are no additional objects or background details present.
title: Eagle
